mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3.5% for six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which increases the probability of aggressive central bank rate hikes and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of six consecutive monthly CPI > 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls above 200,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three consecutive monthly PAYEMS > 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts below 1,200,000 for four consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of four consecutive monthly HOUST < 1,200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index below 101.0 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive monthly INDPRO < 101.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) above $700 billion for three consecutive months signals increased precautionary savings and reduced consumer spending, which weakens corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive monthly RSAFS > $700 billion (t-test p > 0.05).
